decisions.reason: The existing message-19 MODIFY already removes the source-collection and topic constraints made obsolete when the trial clip was replaced.
The existing message-19 MODIFY already removes the trial-specific hook selection criterion made obsolete by replacing the trial clip.
The existing message-19 MODIFY removes the obsolete trial-batch attributes, and the same-message DEFER already records that the assigned clip delivery obligation is no longer currently actionable.

Removing the trial moment-selection standard does not necessarily eliminate clean visual editing as a future production standard, and the existing message-19 DEFER already captures its current inapplicability to the replaced trial.
